kinds (``{kind: [names]}``): ``gateway_commands`` (slash names), ``locales`` (``<lang>.<surface>``
language-pack layers), ``gateway_transforms`` / ``hooks`` (hook
names), ``callbacks`` (platforms / ``slack:<action_id>``) — live in the running gateway once it reloaded
(``gateway_reloaded``). ``live_now``: the plugin's MCP servers (connected, with their tools, or the
error) and skills, usable in every open chat of the profile from its next turn — the chats also get a
note listing them. ``deferred`` kinds: ``tools`` (Python tool names) and ``prompt`` (section ids)
apply from the next session.

PluginsManageParams.description:
``toggle``: ``key``/``name`` + ``enable``; ``install``: ``identifier``/``repo`` or ``catalog_name``
(+ ``force``, ``enable``, ``ref``); ``update``: ``name`` (+ ``accept_capabilities`` to apply a re-pin
that widened the plugin after the user confirmed the ``delta``); ``remove``: ``name`` (user installs only);
``settings``: ``key`` + ``values`` (``{setting_key: value}``, non-secret schema keys only).
PluginsManageParams.title: PluginsManageParams

PluginsManageResult.description:
``list`` → ``plugins`` + counts; ``toggle`` → ``ok``/``unchanged``/``restart_required``/``name``
(the canonical key written)/``plugin``; ``install`` → ``hermes_cli.plugins_cmd.dashboard_install_plugin``'s
ok payload; ``toggle``/``install``/``update`` that loaded a plugin also carry ``gateway_reloaded`` (the
running gateway picked it up and re-wired its handlers) and ``activation`` — the honest split of what is
live now vs deferred, so ``restart_required`` is True only when no gateway answered; ``update`` → ``ok``/``unchanged``/``sha``, or ``ok=false`` + ``consent_required`` with the
``delta`` (``{surface: [added...]}``) / ``delta_lines`` a widened pin adds — nothing changed until the
client retries with ``accept_capabilities``; ``remove`` → ``ok``/``name`` plus
``cleared_memory_provider`` when the removed plugin was the live ``memory.provider``.

ProviderLimit.title: ProviderLimit

ProviderUsage.description:
``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_apply_usage`` — the provider's subscription usage, from cache.

Multi-entry credential pools carry ``accounts`` (one row per account; the legacy ``windows``
stays EMPTY there — a provider-wide percentage across different logins would be fabricated).
Single-account providers keep the legacy ``windows`` gauge.
ProviderUsage.title: ProviderUsage

ProviderUsageAccount.description:
One account of a provider's credential pool (``hermes_cli/inventory.py::_pool_usage_accounts``).
``id`` is a stable non-secret account identity (never a key or URL); ``label`` may be empty (UI
falls back to a localized "Account N"). ``windows`` is empty while the account's usage is not
yet known — state carries the meaning, never a fabricated gauge.

``state``: ``ready`` — live quota below the cap (numeric windows present); ``limited`` — a live
credential-wide cooldown or exhausted account-scoped quota windows; ``unknown`` — no live
numeric windows (failed/empty fetch, stale snapshot, provider without a usage API);
``unavailable`` — DEAD auth row (kept visible, never a quota row).

``resets_at``: for a limited account, the LATEST of its exhausted account-scoped windows (or a
live cooldown when later); ``None`` when unknown (the frontend renders its own advisory, e.g.
the earliest limited sibling).
ProviderUsageAccount.title: ProviderUsageAccount

ProviderUsageWindow.description:
One subscription usage window (``agent/account_usage.py::AccountUsageWindow``): e.g. the 5-hour
session or the weekly cap, with how much of it is spent and when it rolls over (ISO).

``scope``: ``account`` — exhausting the window exhausts the whole login (Codex session/weekly,
so a limited account's resets_at must wait for it); ``model`` — the window caps only one model
family (Anthropic Opus/Sonnet weekly) and can never imply the account itself is out of quota.
ProviderUsageWindow.title: ProviderUsageWindow

RelayAgentRow.description:
A roster row the Desktop pushes (``tools/bot_relay.py::_normalize_roster_row``); invalid
rows are dropped server-side, so the shape stays open.
RelayAgentRow.title: RelayAgentRow

ReloadMcpParams.description:
Without ``confirm`` the handler may answer ``confirm_required`` (per ``approvals.mcp_reload_confirm``);
``always`` persists the opt-out; ``rev`` is the config revision the caller wants loaded (coalescing).
ReloadMcpParams.title: ReloadMcpParams

RepoDiscoveryPolicyParams.description: The policy the desktop scanned under (short or ``repo_scan_*`` long keys both accepted).
RepoDiscoveryPolicyParams.title: RepoDiscoveryPolicyParams

RollbackRestoreResult.description:
``tools/checkpoint_manager.py::restore`` outcome; ``history_removed`` is added for a full
(non-file) restore that also rewound the live transcript.
RollbackRestoreResult.title: RollbackRestoreResult

Room.description:
``gateway/hosted_rooms.py::_room_from_row`` plus the branch-only keys ``create`` (legacy
adoption), ``state`` (``authority_claim``) and ``rename`` (``event``) add.
Room.title: Room

RoomDriverStatus.description:
``HostedRoomService.status(room_id)``; ``pending_actions`` rows are ``{kind: retry, task_id}``
or the driver's approval action (``kind: approval`` + run/session/approval context).
RoomDriverStatus.title: RoomDriverStatus

RoomMember.description:
One roster row (``hosted_room_discussion.validate_roster``); legacy rooms may carry
pre-normalisation rows, so the set stays open.
RoomMember.title: RoomMember

RoomMemberInput.description: A roster row as the client proposes it; ``validate_roster`` owns the exact rules.
RoomMemberInput.title: RoomMemberInput

SeedMessage.description:
One create-time transcript row (``session_history._coerce_seed_history``); ``text`` is the
legacy alias of ``content``; only ``display_kind: "hidden"`` is accepted from the wire. Clients
forward stored rows verbatim (``_row_id``, ``timestamp``, …) and the coercer drops what it does
not use, so the row stays open.
SeedMessage.title: SeedMessage

SessionArchiveParams.description: ``session_id`` (or its ``session_key`` alias) is a live runtime id first, else a stored id / key / title.
SessionArchiveParams.title: SessionArchiveParams

SessionCompressResult.description:
In-process: the before/after summary + replacement transcript. Compute host: its result passes
through (hence open) with ``turn_isolation``; a lock held elsewhere answers ``compressed: false``.
SessionCompressResult.title: SessionCompressResult

SessionContextBreakdownResult.description:
``agent.context_breakdown.compute_session_context_breakdown`` (empty categories before the agent builds)
plus the per-file context manifest (empty until the agent exists).
SessionContextBreakdownResult.title: SessionContextBreakdownResult

SessionControlDispatch.description: ``_dispatch_envelope`` — the command result's user-visible envelope, every key always present.
SessionControlDispatch.title: SessionControlDispatch

SessionControlParams.description:
``action`` is validated by the handler (unknown / gate actions answer ``4004``), so it stays a
string on the wire; ``SessionControlAction`` lists the accepted set.
SessionControlParams.title: SessionControlParams

SessionControlSnapshot.description:
``_snapshot_control`` — ``revision`` is a hash of the visible state (``""`` when empty);
``updated_at`` is the newest persisted timestamp (``0`` when none).
SessionControlSnapshot.title: SessionControlSnapshot

SessionCwdSetResult.description: The refreshed ``session.info`` view (full agent view, or the lazy shape).
SessionCwdSetResult.title: SessionCwdSetResult

SessionForeignListResult.description: ``unreadable`` counts logs on this page that failed to parse.
SessionForeignListResult.title: SessionForeignListResult

SessionForeignPreviewResult.description: Bounded to the last 40 turns / 8000 chars each; ``already_imported`` is the local id.
SessionForeignPreviewResult.title: SessionForeignPreviewResult

SessionListRow.description:
``methods_session._session_row_summary``; ``resolved_id`` only on a title lookup that followed a
compression lineage to its tip.
SessionListRow.title: SessionListRow

SessionLiveInfo.description:
``tui_gateway/server.py::_session_info`` — the ``session.info`` event and the ``info`` field of
``session.create`` / ``session.resume`` / ``session.activate`` results.
SessionLiveInfo.title: SessionLiveInfo

SessionParams.description: Any method addressed at one live session.
SessionParams.title: SessionParams

SessionResumeParams.description: ``session_id`` is the STORED id (or an exact title); the reply's ``session_id`` is the runtime id.
SessionResumeParams.title: SessionResumeParams

SessionSaveResult.description: Under turn isolation the compute host's result passes through verbatim.
SessionSaveResult.title: SessionSaveResult

SessionSetHiddenParams.description: ``session_id`` is a live runtime id first, else a stored id / key / title.
SessionSetHiddenParams.title: SessionSetHiddenParams

SetupRuntimeCheckResult.description:
``ok=False`` + ``error`` when the resolved model can't be served; ``free_tier_route`` says the
selected route is the welcome host.
SetupRuntimeCheckResult.title: SetupRuntimeCheckResult

SetupStatusResult.description:
``provider_configured`` is the loose answer; the boot record's fields (``ready``,
``free_tier_account``, ``free_tier_route``, ``other_providers``, ``inference_provider``) ride along
on the launch profile. An unknown ``profile`` answers ``ok=False`` + ``error``.
SetupStatusResult.title: SetupStatusResult

SharedMetricsConsentResult.description:
The focused profile's ``telemetry.shared_metrics`` opt-ins. ``send`` is never true while
``enabled`` is false; ``decided`` = either key is written in config.yaml (the shipped defaults
are not an answer) and it is not a ``reask``: an "off" from before the type-ahead fix, offered
once more with the reason.
SharedMetricsConsentResult.title: SharedMetricsConsentResult

SharedMetricsDesktopDailyParams.description:
One finished UTC day of Desktop use, aggregated on the client. ``day`` (YYYY-MM-DD) only latches
a resend and is never recorded; the raw counts are bucketed by the backend.
SharedMetricsDesktopDailyParams.title: SharedMetricsDesktopDailyParams

SharedMetricsDesktopDislikeParams.description:
``signal`` quick_close|cancelled|setting_off_default|rage_click|undo|feature_disabled; ``target`` a
closed code-defined id for that signal (area, flow, action, undo path, feature toggle); ``setting`` a
config key for setting_off_default only (the value is never sent — the backend compares it to the
default).
SharedMetricsDesktopDislikeParams.title: SharedMetricsDesktopDislikeParams

SharedMetricsDesktopFeatureUseParams.description:
``area`` is a Desktop surface id (``command_palette``, ``terminal_pane``, ``settings_<view>`` …);
the backend collapses anything outside its closed set to ``other``.
SharedMetricsDesktopFeatureUseParams.title: SharedMetricsDesktopFeatureUseParams

SharedMetricsDesktopFrictionParams.description:
``kind`` notice_dismissed|error_toast|renderer_crash|backend_disconnect|slow_frame; ``detail`` a
closed code-defined word for that kind (notice id, error category, crash reason, drop reason, frame
duration bucket), never message text.
SharedMetricsDesktopFrictionParams.title: SharedMetricsDesktopFrictionParams

SharedMetricsDesktopOnboardingParams.description: ``step`` a Desktop first-run step id; ``event`` reached|completed|abandoned.
SharedMetricsDesktopOnboardingParams.title: SharedMetricsDesktopOnboardingParams

SharedMetricsSetParams.description: ``send`` is ignored unless ``enabled``; ``first_run`` marks the Desktop first-run answer.
SharedMetricsSetParams.title: SharedMetricsSetParams

SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams.description:
``command`` is the raw typed name (no leading ``/``, no args); the backend canonicalizes it
against the published registry. ``session_id`` scopes the count to that session's profile.
SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams.title: SharedMetricsSlashCommandParams

SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams.description:
``elapsed_ms`` = the client's own launch (TUI process start / Desktop app start) to ready
(TUI gateway ready / Desktop backend attached), measured once per launch by the client. The
client names its surface because a Desktop may attach to a URL/cloud backend where
``HERMES_DESKTOP`` is unset; without it the backend falls back to its own client detection.
``launch_id`` is an opaque per-launch token the backend latches on (never recorded), so a
reconnect re-sending the same launch counts once while a new launch counts again.
SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams.title: SharedMetricsStartupLatencyParams

SharedMetricsUpdateRunParams.description:
One Desktop PACKAGED self-update (electron-updater / App Installer / Store). Source-checkout
hand-offs run ``hermes update`` and are counted from its receipt, never here. Raw words; the
backend buckets them: ``outcome`` success|failed|noop|refused, ``failed_stage``
download|verify|apply|restart, ``mechanism`` the updater strategy kind, ``duration_ms`` wall
time, ``from_commit_date`` the updated-from build's commit time (epoch seconds) when known.
SharedMetricsUpdateRunParams.title: SharedMetricsUpdateRunParams

SkillsManageParams.description:
``query`` is the search text / hub identifier / browse page (digits); ``page`` / ``page_size``
apply to ``browse``.
SkillsManageParams.title: SkillsManageParams

SkillsManageResult.description:
Shape follows the action: ``list`` → ``skills`` (category → names); ``search`` → ``results``;
``install`` → ``installed`` + ``name``; ``browse`` → ``items`` + paging; ``inspect`` → ``info``.
SkillsManageResult.title: SkillsManageResult

SkillsReloadParams.description:
``session_id`` binds the rescan to that session's profile and workspace (project skills);
``profile`` scopes a session-less rescan.
SkillsReloadParams.title: SkillsReloadParams

SkinPayload.description:
``tui_gateway/change_watcher.py::resolve_skin`` — the resolved active skin (``HermesSkin``).
``{}`` when the skin engine failed to load. Colour maps are token → colour string.
SkinPayload.title: SkinPayload

SlashExecResult.description:
Plain worker/plugin text in ``output`` (+ ``warning``), or — when the command was rerouted to
``command.dispatch`` — that method's directive fields with ``type`` set.
SlashExecResult.title: SlashExecResult

SpawnTreeEntry.description: Index row (``server._append_spawn_tree_index``) or a legacy file scan.
SpawnTreeEntry.title: SpawnTreeEntry

SpawnTreeLoadResult.description: The snapshot file as written by ``spawn_tree.save`` (open: the file is the contract).
SpawnTreeLoadResult.title: SpawnTreeLoadResult

StatusUpdatePayload.description: ``server._status_update`` and the direct emitters (goal / loop / heartbeat / process).
StatusUpdatePayload.title: StatusUpdatePayload

StreamDeltaPayload.description:
``prompt_turn._invoke_agent._stream`` (message.delta: ``text`` + optional ``rendered``),
``agent_callbacks._agent_cbs`` (reasoning.delta / thinking.delta), ``tool_progress._progress_reasoning``
(reasoning.available). ``verbose`` rides only when the session's verbose reasoning mode is on.
StreamDeltaPayload.title: StreamDeltaPayload

SubagentEventPayload.description:
``tool_progress._progress_subagent`` — every ``subagent.*`` frame; identity fields are optional
because older emitters omit them and the TUI spawn tree falls back to flat rendering.
SubagentEventPayload.title: SubagentEventPayload

SubagentListResult.description: ``delegations``: recently failed async delegation tasks for the session (durable store), newest first.
SubagentListResult.title: SubagentListResult

SubagentSnapshot.description: ``methods_subagents._SUBAGENT_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS`` projection of one live child record.
SubagentSnapshot.title: SubagentSnapshot

SubagentStatus.description:
Lifecycle of one delegated child (``tools/delegate_tool_child_run.py``); ``failed`` /
``error`` / ``timeout`` / ``interrupted`` / ``completed`` are terminal.
SubagentStatus.title: SubagentStatus

SubagentSteerResult.description: ``queued`` is not ``delivered``: a child past its final tool batch surfaces ``missed_steer``.
SubagentSteerResult.title: SubagentSteerResult

SubagentTailResult.description: ``available`` is false while the child has no live transcript yet (or it was cleaned up).
SubagentTailResult.title: SubagentTailResult

SubscriptionChangeParams.description: Either a target tier (downgrade / same-price change) or ``cancel`` (period-end cancellation).
SubscriptionChangeParams.title: SubscriptionChangeParams

SubscriptionPreviewResult.description: ``_serialize_subscription_preview`` on success; ``effect`` drives the confirm copy.
SubscriptionPreviewResult.title: SubscriptionPreviewResult

SubscriptionStateResult.description: ``_serialize_subscription_state``; the view's fallback emits only ``ok / logged_in / error``.
SubscriptionStateResult.title: SubscriptionStateResult

SubscriptionUpgradeResult.description:
The money route: ``status`` separates a completed upgrade from an SCA / decline that must
finish in the portal at ``recovery_url``; ``idempotency_key`` is echoed (also on error) so a
retry reuses it.
SubscriptionUpgradeResult.title: SubscriptionUpgradeResult

SudoRequestParams.description: Original command, redacted server-side before any password-injection rewrite.
SudoRequestParams.title: SudoRequestParams

TaskIdResult.description:
The side agent runs detached; its answer lands on the parent session as an event carrying
this ``task_id``.
TaskIdResult.title: TaskIdResult

ToolCompletePayload.description: ``tool_progress._on_tool_complete``; ``todos``/``revision`` merged in for the todo tools.
ToolCompletePayload.title: ToolCompletePayload

ToolLabel.description:
``tools.tool_labels.ToolLabel`` — what one call executed through the tool_search bridge is,
in words. Clients render ``text`` (or ``app``/``action`` in their own columns) and never parse
the tool name themselves.
ToolLabel.title: ToolLabel

ToolLabelKind.description: Which surface one inner call of a bridged ``tool_call`` runs on.
ToolLabelKind.title: ToolLabelKind

ToolStartPayload.description:
``tool_progress._on_tool_start`` (+ ``agent_callbacks._mirror_subagent_to_child`` rows with
``preview`` and empty ``args``). ``todos``/``revision`` are NOT set by the emitter; kept optional
because tool.start rows may pass through connector redaction unchanged.
ToolStartPayload.title: ToolStartPayload

ToolsConfigureParams.description:
``names`` are toolset keys or ``server:tool`` MCP targets; with ``session_id`` the live session's
profile is authoritative and its agent is rebuilt.
ToolsConfigureParams.title: ToolsConfigureParams

ToolsetRow.description:
One row of ``methods_tools._toolset_rows``; ``tools`` only when the caller asked for them
(``tools.list``).
ToolsetRow.title: ToolsetRow

TourPreset.description: Which built-in tour ``start`` without steps runs.
TourPreset.title: TourPreset

TranscriptMessage.description:
One transcript row as the gateway PROJECTS it for renderers (``session_history._project_history``):
``text``, display-only ``timestamp`` / ``display_kind`` / ``display_metadata``, the durable ``row_id``
rewind targets, and for tool rows raw ``content``, ``tool_call_id``, ``name``, ``context`` and ``args``.
Assistant detail sidecars (``reasoning``, …) ride as extra keys.
TranscriptMessage.title: TranscriptMessage

UsageBar.description: ``_serialize_usage_bar``: one bar, magnitudes pre-formatted; ``pct_used`` only for ``plan``.
UsageBar.title: UsageBar

UsageModel.description:
``_serialize_usage_model`` — also embedded as ``usage`` in the billing / subscription states,
where the fail-open form is a bare ``{available: false}`` (no ``ok``).
UsageModel.title: UsageModel

ValueResult.description:
The answer to any one-string prompt (sudo, secret, vault prompts, desktop bridges):
``''`` means skipped / declined.
ValueResult.title: ValueResult

VaultAddParams.description: ``secret`` goes straight into the encrypted store; the result carries only the new id.
VaultAddParams.title: VaultAddParams

VaultUnlockParams.description: The master password is consumed by the manager CLI and never stored or logged.
VaultUnlockParams.title: VaultUnlockParams

VerificationStatusInfo.description:
``verification_status()``: ``disabled`` / ``not_applicable`` / ``unverified`` / ``stale`` or the
latest event's own status; ``root`` and friends only once a workspace was identified.
VerificationStatusInfo.title: VerificationStatusInfo

VoicePartialPayload.description: ``methods_voice`` voice.record ``on_partial`` — live STT text so far (``stt.streaming``).
VoicePartialPayload.title: VoicePartialPayload

VoiceStatusPayload.description: ``methods_voice._vr_on_status``; states come from the recorder (idle / listening / transcribing …).
VoiceStatusPayload.title: VoiceStatusPayload

VoiceToggleResult.description:
``methods_voice.py::_voice_status_payload`` (+ the requirements probe on ``status``, the spoken
stop hint on ``on``).
VoiceToggleResult.title: VoiceToggleResult

WakeFeedParams.description: ``pcm`` (or the ``pcm_b64`` alias): base64 int16 mono little-endian, 16 kHz only.
WakeFeedParams.title: WakeFeedParams

WakeInputDevice.description: ``tools/wake_word.py::_describe_input_device`` — PortAudio diagnostics for the configured mic.
WakeInputDevice.title: WakeInputDevice

WakeStartParams.description:
``surface`` names the caller ("tui" | "gui"); ``persist`` is the explicit gesture that also
flips ``wake_word.enabled`` on; ``client_capture`` asks for PCM streamed via wake.feed.
WakeStartParams.title: WakeStartParams

WakeStartResult.description:
``started: false`` carries ``reason`` (unavailable / disabled / disabled_for_surface / owned);
``sample_rate`` / ``frame_length`` describe the PCM frames the armed detector expects.
WakeStartResult.title: WakeStartResult

WakeStatusResult.description:
``enabled`` is config truth; ``listening`` is this caller's armed detector; ``audio_silent``
means armed but deaf (see ``hint``).
WakeStatusResult.title: WakeStatusResult

_SessionScoped.description:
Handlers that look a live session up with ``_sessions.get(params.get("session_id"))``: an
absent / unknown id falls back to the launch profile's config, so it is never required.
_SessionScoped.title: _SessionScoped
